articles.summary: Marking an incredible five years of Guidewire's presence in Malaysia, the Kuala Lumpur office banded together recently to empower the youth in their local community by supporting them to explore future careers in IT. Read about the team's volunteering day with Guidewire Gives Back, supported by our women-led ERG, GROW.
articles.title: Inspiring the Future: Kuala Lumpur's Volunteer Day
